overview: Tenebrous Ridge is the windswept plateau of the Tenebrous Mountains, shaped by nocturnal predators and resonance winds.
history: The ridge formed from ancient volcanic uplift and Umbral erosion.
Lightcrawler swarms adapted to the highland environment, becoming nocturnal apex hunters.
Akhevan scouts established ridge vantage points for shadow incursions.
Vampyric raiders use the ridge to ambush weakened travelers at night.
hooks: A resonance wind surge mutates a Lightcrawler swarm.
Akhevan scouts attempt to seize a Vampyric vantage point.
Umbral winds intensify, altering ridge hazards.
A new predator den appears after a ridge collapse.
